fusions.name: Seeded Wound
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 4 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 6 seconds, and has a 25% chance to leave it [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Rotting Lure
fusions.desc: Seeds up to 3 bodies in reach with spores for 30 seconds. Each bursts for 26 damage the moment an enemy comes within 2 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Spore Shroud
fusions.desc: Veils you in spores for 8 seconds and raises your movement speed by 10%. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Spores Move On
fusions.desc: When a condition you inflicted runs out, spores burst to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
